review.comment.note: ledger row: review.comment — insertComment runs openCommentDialog() (editor.js:1346/4348): #comment-dialog.dialog-overlay gains .open (style.css .dialog-overlay.open display:flex) with body textarea + cancel/comment actions

review.add-comment.note: ledger row: review.add-comment — the collaboration-tab #btn-comment click listener IS openCommentDialog (editor.js:8730), same #comment-dialog surface as insertComment

review.co-editing-mode.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-06: dialog-input selectOption fires the change event the synthetic click could not; the runner now arms wo:coedit-mode in the event collector and dialog-input asserts dispatch (strict -> wo:coedit-mode {mode:'strict'})

review.delete.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-07: ledger row review.delete — ctx-menu-on-comment pre builds the span.comment fixture the old note called a vocabulary gap; the collaboration-tab [data-cmd=deleteComment] ribbon button then runs deleteComment (editor.js:1468) -> commentAtSelection() (anchor inside the fixture span) -> removeComment (editor.js:141) unwraps it, so #editor span.comment goes absent (dom-mutation)

review.resolve.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-07: ledger row review.resolve — ctx-menu-on-comment pre anchors the selection inside the fixture span.comment; [data-cmd=resolveComment] runs resolveComment (editor.js:1456) -> toggleResolved (editor.js:128) flips data-resolved="1" (afterTrackEdit only marks history/collab state, the attribute survives), so #editor span.comment[data-resolved=1] becomes present (dom-mutation, default want=present)

review.track-changes.note: ledger row: review.track-changes — #btn-track-changes click emits toggleTrackChanges, syncs #tc-enabled and opens trackchanges-dialog via openOverlayDialog (editor.js:8724)

review.previous.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row review.previous — navigateTrackedChange(-1) (editor.js:4293) needs the caret strictly AFTER a change end to flash (.nav-flash) and select it; the ctx-menu-trackchanges pre anchors the caret inside the only fixture change (selectNodeContents on the ins), so the walk takes the Status.NoPrevChange path and the success effect is unobservable with the fixed fixture vocabulary

review.next.note: KNOWN GAP: ledger row review.next — navigateTrackedChange(1) needs the caret strictly BEFORE a change start to flash (.nav-flash) and select it; the ctx-menu-trackchanges pre anchors the caret inside the only fixture change, so the walk takes the Status.NoNextChange path and the success effect is unobservable with the fixed fixture vocabulary

review.accept.note: ledger row: review.accept — acceptTrackedChange runs trackedChangeAtSelection("accept") (editor.js:1454/3041) on the ins.track-insert at the caret; acceptChange unwraps the insertion into plain text (same path as the passing ctx.accept-change)

review.reject.note: ledger row: review.reject — rejectTrackedChange runs trackedChangeAtSelection("reject") (editor.js:1455); rejectChange removes the tracked insertion entirely (same path as the passing ctx.reject-change)

statusbar.status-btn-multiple-pages.note: ledger row: statusbar.status-btn-multiple-pages — #btn-multipage click runs setMultipage (editor.js:13023): toggles body.multi-page-view page-separator gutters + aria-pressed on the statusbar/View mirrors. NOTE: the zoom ledger rows statusbar.btn-zoom-topage/btn-zoom-towidth (both bound to #btn-zoom-fit, fit-width only) are deliberately NOT contracted here: any click on #btn-zoom-fit persists wo-zoom=1.81205 in localStorage and breaks the downstream relative-zoom contracts (view-flags btn-zoom-out 1→0.9, btn-zoom-in 0.9→1) that run later in manifest order and assume a fresh zoom=1; #btn-zoom-fit has no post-hoc reset hook in the runner vocabulary (post runs before the effect check)
